page.title: 附件组件场景测试
page.description: 按 view.json 场景分 Tab 试用与选型；文案与目录编码均由 gen JSON 驱动。
page.pickRowSingleImage: 单图封面/Logo → AttachmentManager mode=single variant=image
page.pickRowMultiList: 多文件列表 → AttachmentManager mode=multiple variant=list
page.pickRowCatalog: 配置目录多槽位（名称/要求/文件表）→ CatalogAttachmentManager；目录编码来自 view.json fileCatalogs（样例 catalog=attachment_demo）。完整闭环见菜单「附件测试业务」。
page.bizLoopHint: 完整业务闭环（建表/保存/引用同步/删除）：基础设施 → 文件配置中心 → 附件测试业务
page.pickRowWrappers: 轮播等其它单图场景同样用 AttachmentManager，只换 bizType（如 FILE_BIZ_BANNER_IMAGE）；勿再引入 CoverImagePicker / OaFileUpload
page.pickRowSpecial: 头像裁剪 / 富文本内嵌 / 管理端存储上传 → 继续用手写特殊组件
page.whenMultiList: OA 附件、表单 file 字段、任意多文件列表。
page.whenCatalog: 业务表单按 infra_file_catalog（view.json fileCatalogs）配置多槽位规则表上传。
page.whenBannerImage: 轮播图等：bizType=banner_image，downloadScope=infra；与公告封面同一组件，只换常量。
page.whenSpecial: 勿用 AttachmentManager 替换的特殊交互。
page.snippetSingleImage:
import { AttachmentManager, FILE_BIZ_NOTICE_COVER, FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_NOTICE } from '@/components/attachment'

<AttachmentManager
  v-model="form.coverFileId"
  v-model:preview-url="form.coverPreviewUrl"
  :biz-type="FILE_BIZ_NOTICE_COVER"
  :download-scope="FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_NOTICE"
  mode="single"
  variant="image"
/>
page.snippetMultiList:
import { AttachmentManager, FILE_BIZ_OA_INSTANCE, FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_INFRA } from '@/components/attachment'

<AttachmentManager
  v-model="form.fileIds"
  :biz-type="FILE_BIZ_OA_INSTANCE"
  :download-scope="FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_INFRA"
  mode="multiple"
  variant="list"
  :max-files="5"
/>
page.snippetCatalog:
import { CatalogAttachmentManager } from '@/components/attachment'
import viewConfig from '@/i18n/gen/yourBiz/view.json'

// catalogCode 取自 view.json fileCatalogs[].code
<CatalogAttachmentManager
  v-model="form.attachments"
  :catalog-code="viewConfig.fileCatalogs[0].code"
  :biz-id="form.id"
  @change="({ fileIds }) => (form.fileIds = fileIds)"
/>
page.snippetBannerImage:
import { AttachmentManager, FILE_BIZ_BANNER_IMAGE, FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_INFRA } from '@/components/attachment'

<AttachmentManager
  v-model="form.imageFileId"
  v-model:preview-url="form.imageUrl"
  :biz-type="FILE_BIZ_BANNER_IMAGE"
  :download-scope="FILE_DOWNLOAD_SCOPE_INFRA"
  mode="single"
  variant="image"
/>
